display.notes: Use rarely and only for true product-level moments.

body.notes: Prioritize readable density over marketing flourish.

elevationMeta.philosophy: Canvas first. Depth comes from floating rails, sparse notes, hairlines, and shallow ambient shadows.

navigation.rule: Use a floating left rail with outcome-facing nouns. Hide implementation nouns unless trust or admin context requires them.

brief.rule: The first authenticated surface sits directly on the full-screen canvas with sparse notes for today's work, recent outcomes, and items needing review.

cards.maxRadius: 16px for canvases, 14px for pages, 10px for cards
cards.rule: Use page surfaces for writing and connected cards for canvas objects.

accessibilityMeta.color: Color-blind safe; status must include text or icon support.
